articles.description: Matt Roffe, who will lead the Chicago White Sox domestic draft duties, most recently worked for the Milwaukee Brewers as assistant director of domestic scouting.
articles.title: Chicago White Sox to hire Matt Roffe from Milwaukee Brewers to fill amateur scouting director role

articles.description: The Chicago White Sox informed John Schriffen that his contract will not be extended as the club’s lead television play-by-play announcer.
articles.title: Chicago White Sox part ways with television play-by-play announcer John Schriffen

articles.description: The Chicago White Sox had a turnaround for the ages. So what’s the next step for a franchise that went from three consecutive 100-plus-loss seasons between 2023-25 to the postseason in 2026?
articles.title: After a turnaround for the ages, Chicago White Sox eye pitching and outfield depth in their offseason plans
